new_findings_today.title: /explore initial render shows only 16 destination links pre-scroll (lazy load expands to 80 after scroll)

Today's initial snapshot was 16 destination links; after scrolling to the bottom twice (1.5s + 1.0s + 1.5s settle), the count expanded to 80 destination links, confirming the page uses progressive/lazy rendering rather than a regression. Not a defect — recording so future runs treat post-scroll counts as the canonical metric and avoid mis-reading the pre-scroll snapshot as a regression.
